notes.title: Spirittea: Phantom Friends Update is LIVE on Nintendo Switch & Xbox!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42404813/e59d480b363b658d912c09d911f3fc046a9db379.png[/img]

Hi everyone!

[b]The Phantom Friends Update is LIVE on Nintendo Switch & Xbox![/b]

We've been working hard behind the scenes in getting this update out to you lovely console people, so we're super glad we can pass it over to you! 

Not only this, but you can [b]grab Spirittea for 40% OFF right now[/b] as part of the Great Ormond Street Hospital Charity sale, with proceeds going towards a children's cancer centre!

Need a reminder on what you can expect to find in this update? Don't worry, here's a little refresher:

[b]SPIRIT PETS![/b] You'll now be able to summon spirits as pets, using pet shrines! Hunt down pet ritual scrolls for help on how to summon them, and you'll have your own spirit companion that might be a bit less grumpy (sorry Wonyan)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42404813/e6b6aa5a079f3589cc150849fa0ab3e09b66e373.gif[/img]

[b]NEW SPIRITS & QUESTS![/b] You'll find some new spirits about town which you'll need to have your spirit vision ready for... what possibly could they want?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42404813/e25a9110b2db6dfec2c8cb35d38ae181dc54f24d.gif[/img]

One of the new spirits you'll find is a [b]SPIRIT MERCHANT![/b] You may need their help during one of the quests, or when it's time to summon a spirit, so make sure your spirituality is high enough...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42404813/ab2ae90a6c21f24e3aa81e46a0b256fba3caee46.gif[/img]

Alongside these you can find loads of bug fixes, and more new content to accommodate the new features! We hope you all enjoy this super cute update, and thanks again for your patience!

Have a great time pet hunting - we'll see you soon!

- Cheesemaster Games & No More Robots

notes.title: Spirittea - Phantom Friends Update!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42404813/f42d03de38e7192f4eaf269cb1576051b9569b31.png[/img]

Hi everyone!

We're finally here with another update, and it's a big one - [b]the Phantom Friends Update![/b]

We have a whole host of exciting new content in this update, including SPIRITS which we know you have all been dying to see more of! [b]To make things even better, you can grab Spirittea for 30% OFF in the Steam Autumn sale which goes live today![/b] Enough from us though, should we get into it?

[b]SPIRIT PETS![/b] You'll now be able to summon spirits as pets, using pet shrines! Hunt down pet ritual scrolls for help on how to summon them, and you'll have your own spirit companion that might be a bit less grumpy (sorry Wonyan)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42404813/e6b6aa5a079f3589cc150849fa0ab3e09b66e373.gif[/img]

[b]NEW SPIRITS & QUESTS![/b] You'll find some new spirits about town which you'll need to have your spirit vision ready for... what possibly could they want?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42404813/e25a9110b2db6dfec2c8cb35d38ae181dc54f24d.gif[/img]

One of the new spirits you'll find is a [b]SPIRIT MERCHANT![/b] You may need their help during one of the quests, or when it's time to summon a spirit, so make sure your spirituality is high enough...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42404813/ab2ae90a6c21f24e3aa81e46a0b256fba3caee46.gif[/img]

And as always, we fixed a truckload of bugs, and added a bunch of quality of life improvements and more content to accommodate the new additions in this update! Here's the full breakdown:
[list]
[*] Added Poegs to the game - it's a spirit pig that can be fed different foods and produces different coloured spirit essences (used in creating pets at pet shrine). Appears in-game if you've been in town until at least the 5th of the first year
[*] Added Poeg detector to spirit shop inventory. It can show where the Poeg is located on the map screen (a little white pig icon)
[*] Added pet shrines to the game, which can be used to summon pets
[*] Added pet ritual scrolls to the game (instructions on how to create pets)
[*] Added pet shrine to secret shop inventory
[*] Added pet shrine to Song's shop rotation
[*] Added pet shrine to secret shrine room
[*] Added a NEW spirit merchant. Will only be visible and active as a shop if spirituality is more than or equal to 100
[*] Added ability to scrub spirits for spirit materials (using broom)
[*] Added new flower shrine quest (started once player unlocks the pond in the bathhouse)
[*] Added a flower shrine to outside of the bathhouse area
[*] Added spirit flowers types around town 
[*] Added 10 lion's mane spirit flowers around town
[*] Added water to bathhouse upgradable pond
[*] When the bathhouse pond has been upgraded, a watering can is spawned in front of it. The watering can is also added to the recovery shrine at this time. The watering can cannot be sold at the selling shrine
[*] Added veggies to Ito's truck shop. Each day Ito is in town, 2 random veggies that grow in the wild can be sold at his truck shop. The next time Ito is in town, the veggies will be randomly picked again (so it's possible to see the same veggie again)
[*] Added lasagna & the recipe for it
[*] Ensured that Song's shop will be selling the spaghetti recipe, noodles, tomatoes and beef during the stage of the spirit quest where lasagna needs to be fed to the Poeg
[*] Added tutorial for ceiling and floor brooms (the floor broom specifically describes how to get spirit materials)
[*] Revised the backup achievement code check which triggers when you load your save file. It will check more efficiently if you've been in town at least one year and should have the Countryside Experience achievement
[*] Fixed a bug where Kurkapi and Ribbard's songs wouldn't end when they were done bathing, or the bathhouse was closed
[*] Fixed bug where playing the drinking minigame 6 times soft locked the minigame, and didn't naturally end with dialogue from an NPC
[*] Fixed issue with Kim's quest's spirit where the spirit's depth was off when sitting in the tea fields (making it so the player could stand over top of its sprite when the player should be behind it)
[*] Fixed Maru and Sora's positioning on Tuesday and Thursday nights at 8pm (should be by the temple but were teleporting to the school)
[*] Fixed "controller is disconnected" message font size for non-English languages
[*] Added option to in-game menu to adjust deadzone level of joysticks
[*] Added option to in-game menu to have the game auto detect controller inputs for you, or to manually set the controller being used
[*] Added Aurum's background information to his spirit charm (updated when spirit tome is dug up)
[*] Fixed Corvink's bathing type to be "Swimmer" instead of Regular
[*] Adjusted spirit material drop rate to 45% chance and decreased required scrub time from 6 seconds to 5.5 seconds
[*] Added a Wonyan scrubbing reminder/tutorial that triggers in the center of the main bathhouse room if the Poeg quest is done, and if the tutorial hasn't been triggered yet
[/list]
We hope you all enjoy this super cute update! We'll let you know soon about when you can expect this update to drop on console, so keep an eye out! 

Until next time, and good luck in your Poeg hunting!

- Cheesemaster Games & No More Robots

notes.title: Introducing the Moving & Grooving Update!

Hi everyone!

We're back with another Spirittea update - [b]the Moving & Grooving Update![/b] To celebrate, you can grab Spirittea for 30% OFF right now!

This update brings some cool new content, alongside some quality of life changes & more bug fixes which we know you're going to love!

[h3]Here's what you can expect to find:
[/h3]

[b]New NPC animations![/b] We've finally added more animations to the townsfolk, so now when you walk around, you'll see them engaging in more activities and doing more with their daily routines!

[list]
[*] Fixed bug where large bath would remain frozen if heaters were placed on left or right side of bath
[*] Finished adding Gale's, Jan's, Julian's, Kenzo’s, Ling’s, Maru’s and Kim’s animations
[*] Changed how the shovel, net and rod look in water reflections
[*] Fixed crashes around wind and atmosphere audio
[*] Fixed a bug where blank spots in Fenias's shop would appear as a value of -1 if the player scrolled vertically
[*] If an item disappears when moving between rooms, a pop up now occurs to highlight to the developers there has been an issue. The player will then be holding an invisible object rather than the game crashing like before.

[*] Added in all the new localised text!
[*] Added a new face to the character customisation at the start of the game

[*] Added 3 atmospheric cicada sound effects for summer
[*] Removed friendship gained from digging at a spot already dug up
[*] Fixed a bug where if the season changed to spring or summer and Jillian or Yari came to town, they wouldn't have the correct friendship level (unless the game was re-loaded from the main menu)
[*] Boosted pumpkin grow chance from 30% to 70%
[/list]
And that's all! We hope you have a ton of fun with this new update, stay tuned for the next one - we'll see you soon!

notes.title: Spirittea's Hook, Line & Spirit update is OUT NOW!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

It's time for another big update to Spirittea! This time, we have been working on a big new feature, and a whole host of bugs have been taken care of! Are you ready to go FISHING?

Since our last update, we've been looking at feedback and watching folks play. Something we really wanted to make more engaging was the fishing minigame - so we totally redesigned it! From today, you can play the brand new minigame (complete with new targeting!) or switch in the options to keep the old minigame and play as you have been - it's totally up to you! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42404813/54c48984e7338b0875bf4461bb4cbfc9d3070db7.gif[/img]

The [b]new fishing system[/b] comes with a brand new casting bar to make sure you hit your target every time, then dives down under the waves to put you in control of reeling in your latest catch - can you time your fishing just right before your line snaps and [b]you're[/b] sent reeling?

Every fish will have some stamina; it's up to you to outlast them, but keep your precious rod in one piece!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42404813/7d24185334fbb94c2b61480fb259af342b1e6166.gif[/img]

Alongside the new fishing, here are some quality-of-life changes & bug fixes we've added:

[list]
[*] You can now toggle how dark it is at night to help you navigate better
[*] Added a STREAMER MODE in the options to better hide away details about you in Moby's quest
[*] Fixed a bunch of spooky bugs where some ducks could be deleted unintentionally, or their reflections would sit in baths where they weren't!
[*] Made it so the big cherry blossom by the bathhouse goes transparent when the player walks behind it (to help with finding sakura blossoms)
[*] Fixed it so that Spirits no longer leave towels in the unreachable void if you suddenly leave the bathhouse
[*] Added ice (and icey sounds!!) to the rice paddies in winter
[*] Fixed bug where karaoke on PC would display correct key bindings but would only accept default inputs
[*] Added ability to change the text finished sound or to remove it completely
[*] Added floor and ceiling brooms to Song's shop. Change the camera, repair kit, retro TV, quest for the end II, stinker statue, and Gamestation 7 to be able to be purchased more than once (for people that lost/sold them)
[*] Added a Kenzo hotspring animation!
[*] Fixed an issue where spirits would sometimes disappear when you put them in a bath
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42404813/433a8923c3fe1edf5d4f12603d1b28d6cde59687.gif[/img]

We hope you enjoy the new fishing - there's more where that came from! You can grab Spirittea now at 30% OFF and we'll see you next time!

Hello everyone!

We’ve got a new Spirittea update for you, which includes more bug fixes and small quality of life additions!

[h3]To kick things off and to tide you over until the next big update, you can grab Spirittea for 20% OFF right now![/h3]

[h3]Here's what you can expect to find in today's update:
[/h3]

[b]Inventory stacking![/b] We know you've all been waiting for this, and we're more than happy to deliver! Now, if you have more than one of the same item in your inventory, it'll stack instead of taking separate inventory slots! It'll stack in other places with storage too, like the chest in your house, fridges, etc. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42404813/47faa09c875889af6fe353496058384cda8b6838.png[/img]

And here's the full list of bug fixes and quality of life improvements: 

[list]
[*] Fixed issues with Morinoba’s dialogue when playing on Steam Deck
[*] Added a sleeping animation for Fae
[*] The poobirds now have sound effects!
[*] The train carriage destroy event has been replaced with a clean up event
[*] The boiler can’t be accessed until specific parts of the tutorial, to avoid unintended behavior
[*] The invisible blocker during the bathhouse tutorial is now more prominent, to stop players from breaking the tutorial and accidentally leaving at the wrong time
[*] Added more clarification to the bathhouse upgrades UI when you pay for an upgrade. It will now be indicated the day the upgrade will be finished and will inform the player that Fae will finish the upgrade at the end of her work day
[*] The player can now run the bathhouse on the weekend, even when Fae has an upgrade scheduled, as she doesn’t work on the weekend

[*] Fixed a bug where Lord Spirit text would cause time to freeze when moving between rooms
[*] Quests on the board and notebook will now complete regardless of whether you’ve spoken to the relevant NPC to tie up the quest
[*] Fixed a bug where the selling shrine would display -1 as a price

[h3]What's next for Spirittea?
[/h3]

We have some big plans for Spirittea in 2024, so we thought we'd give you a sneak peek of what's to come in the next big update!

[b]Seasonal factors![/b] The changing in seasons is a big part of Spirittea, and we were thinking on how we could make this even better and more immersive. So, we thought, why not make the change in seasons even more obvious?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42404813/1b63dde29110a86b919f6a3ff4ba78f23bf01ad7.png[/img]
Now, whenever you're working in the bathhouse, you'll see the environment interact with you even more, depending on the season! In winter, you'll find ice in the baths, in Fall you'll see leaves falling into the baths, and in Spring you'll see Algae growing in them! (We know, more things to clean, sorry!)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42404813/7367c119f66813eb4bcbee1a8ddc1adc2ff8483a.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42404813/e836213aa29c23f2a575f1e9200b6d98c49b848d.png[/img]
[b]A new NPC vendor![/b] The town can never have enough shops and vendors, so we thought we'd add another! This truck will drive through town occasionally, so be sure to be on time when it arrives! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42404813/b5b7b94aa042523d581313d19190e44168988318.png[/img]
This vendor will sell a bunch of new in-game items, including heaters for the bathhouse to keep your spirits warm during the winter, duck nests so you have ducks in your bathhouse, and more!

[b]Improved character portraits![/b] The characters in Spirittea are a big part of the game, especially considering how much time you spend with them, so we wanted to give them even more life and personality!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42404813/2a9d5a7527ff14a38df7627794bf8101f7ca108c.png[/img]

Now, as you increase your friendships with them, you'll notice their character portraits change the better friends you become with them!

notes.title: Dev Update - Meet the Spirits: Introducing Coronis!

notes.title: Dev Update - Early bird or night owl?
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

It's update time, and today we wanted to talk to you a little more about the freedom Spirittea gives you to play however you want, and that includes when you choose to sleep and stay awake!

Your schedule in Spirittea is ENTIRELY up to you, so if you want to be an early bird and wake up in the morning to do all of your daily activities, then go ahead! But if you prefer to sleep during the day and wander about at night, then of course you can do that too!

As long as you get the right amount of sleep for your fatigue, you can do whatever you like whenever you like, whether it's during the warm day or the cool summer evening!

[h3]There'll be plenty of secret things about that you'll only be able to find at certain times, especially at night, so it might be worth going for a bit of an evening stroll. I wonder what this could be...[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42404813/962889ec59fa2712d3da5f29b00b3afd3910db89.gif[/img]

[h3]The bathhouse has no limits either, so if you prefer to work in the bathhouse at night, then by all means take on the night shift!
[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42404813/3d2f33c05b1b88b098a73da31b7d3640b51844fd.gif[/img]

Some of the people in town are night owls too, so you'll spot them hanging about and enjoying the quiet evenings.

Thanks again for tuning in to another great update! We're gonna hit the hay, we've got some fireflies to catch this evening!

notes.title: Dev Update - Friendships

notes.title: Dev Update - You've Got Mail!

notes.title: Dev Update - A Helping Hand
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, it's that time again! 

Last week's update really was massive for us, we've [i](I've)[/i] been waiting for what feels like FOREVER to tell you a little bit about the notice board! It's made such a big change to the game and really driven all of us as we've played it to seek out as many of the Spirits and their stories as possible! We really hope it brings you as close to the world as it does us!

This week, I wanted to touch on two more ways we're helping to integrate players with the world. It's always a really hard task to marry up what we know we'd like people to experience, and guide them towards it thoughtfully. No one wants naggy companions or to be thoroughly clueless, but sometimes that balance can be tough! 

The feeling throughout, we think is that there should be help where you need it, without feeling super weighed down, and this applies everywhere! In the bathhouse, for example, we want to make sure you know what's going on throughout so you can better plan, but there's a fair bit to keep track of. We figured that by doing more things around town, you should be rewarded, so for completing one of the Spirit Quests you will take on the help of MY ABSOLUTE FAVOURITE UNIT. If your main fire has died, you'll hear a crow throughout the bathhouse letting you know - what a lovely, helpful bean this spirit is! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42404813/4e23bf9505d444a17101d5307b6a3f532db3b51a.gif[/img]

Around town, there'll be a lot to keep track of in regards to helping the spirits - luckily as a writer, you're pretty proficient with a notebook and pen, so you'll be taking all manner of notes as you get to know the town and its problems! Wonyan might even be able to help you with some spirit insider knowledge if you end up getting a bit stuck! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42404813/c5ad44054898cf78fdb5a7494ad2aca03de20378.png[/img]

All in all, it's a difficult balance to strike, but know Spirittea is looking more and more player friendly every day! There's real care and thought going into each aspect, and we can't wait for you to dive in! The question is, are you a hint type of person, or do you prefer to puzzle your way through things directly? Let us know, and we'll see you next week!

notes.title: Dev Update - A Neighbourly Notice Board!
notes.notes:
Hey there everyone! - it's time for a lovely long update! We will return to posting more regular updates soon - keep your eyes peeled!

Are you sitting comfortably? I hope you are, because we've got some stories to tell! We're so excited to finally shine a little spotlight on a feature that's still being worked on, but has become a fast favourite of ours over at No More Robots - the town now has:

[h2][b]a little notice board! [/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42404813/83ea11246030352ff65a9eb85d3c9c52217f426d.gif[/img]

As you'll know from seeing our updates and playing the demo, the local spirits have forgotten themselves and are causing mischief throughout the town. Whenever spirits cause someone a tough time, that person will post a little note asking for help! Each person has their own way of writing and style of note so you'll get to learn a little bit about each one just through their requests!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42404813/804393eddcf2c1ff42f47c720ec9984a0ca0e1d2.png[/img]

Alongside your routine of opening the bathhouse, hanging out with the locals and seeing what the shops have to offer, you'll be able to drop by the board and see if there are any new spooky goings-on for you to investigate, ranging from missing tools and sleeping in to vandals and worse!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42404813/5460f20591af46d6ddcc6d834f78077d859947c9.png[/img]

Once you've chatted to them and their friends about their issue, you'll be able to investigate to your heart's content, as long as you don't run out of Spirittea! 

We wanted to make sure you always had lots of things to choose from in game to do, and you could easily make a choice based on what you like, and who you like throughout the town - this board will highlight new options for you and give you lots of inspiration for your novel along the way!

notes.title: Spirittea Dev Update - Welcome Home!
notes.notes:

Hey everyone! I'm here with another Spirittea update, that kind of leads on from the last video we did - I've filled my house with mice! 

If you're not sure what I'm talking about, head back to our collectables video to find out where all these cute little dudes have come from - but I realised we haven't spoken much about the house, and the bits and pieces you can do inside it! 

You'll be welcomed to the house when you first arrive by lovely Amelia, but she notices you're missing a desk to write at - a pretty key bit of furniture for a writer! Thankfully, there's a bunch of furniture at the shop, let's quickly hop over there and grab some extra bits... Hmm, I wonder what else I can buy?

Throughout the game, you'll be able to find and buy a whole host of pieces of furniture, decorations, rugs for floors and wallpapers! Not all of them will be as easy to grab as these, but you'll be able to decorate your house as you like it - our houses in No More Robots are all very different! You can also fill your house with trinkets! From our little mouse friends, we gathered last week to some of the nice trinkets hanging around the town, feel free to decorate your house with whatever you pick up - even if it's a pair of slippers you've taken a liking to!

I'm hoping you'll have lots of fun decorating and comparing your houses, but don't forget that's not all they're good for! This screen up here JUST got finished! Would anyone like to do some cooking?

notes.title: Dev Update - Take Your Time!
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=hGfVANXlVwY;full][/previewyoutube]

Hey everyone, it's time for another little Spirittea update! With Winter giving us one last snow before the Spring, I figured I'd show you a little of how time passes in the game, and what that means for your character, the town, the townspeople and the spirits!

If you've played our demo, you'll know that the lovely clock in the top right-hand corner tells you the time and date, as well as what season it currently is. As you sleep each day, the days will tick on and eventually you'll hit summer, autumn and winter. We showed a little of these seasons in our music video, but here's a quick look at what you can expect, alongside different things growing and different critters hanging around town!

It wouldn't be a slice-of-life game without a lovely day-night cycle, and in Spirittea you'll see a lovely dawn, midday sun (as long as it's not cloudy, raining or storming), dusk and night-time, as well as a lovely drawn reminder of the clocks turning midnight! You'll even notice the difference in the bathhouse, where each time of day sets a different atmosphere!

But that's not the only difference! Each NPC has their own routine - some of the folks work at the school and the various buildings downtown so will take time in their day to head out to work, as well as engage with hobbies, meet with friends or just take some time out to relax. No matter what time of day you head out into town, there'll always be someone up to something! 

As well as the townspeople, the spirits also have their own routines - they like to cause chaos when they can, some of them waiting until the relevant humans have left for work, others waiting for their humans to come home to best annoy them! On top of this, they're also tied to the seasons as you'll have seen in our previous videos - you'll need to be flexible with your own schedule in order to meet and help them all! 

That being said, if you're a night owl, there'll be things for you to do and discover at night just like in the day! This is your new town and your new life - it's totally up to you how you spend it!

So, will you be a night owl headed out for karaoke or some late-night drinks, or an early bird looking to make the most of the daylight? Let us know in the comments and we'll see you next week!

From digging for treasure to eating BBQ, everyone has a preference. But with us celebrating, I figured I'd show you my favourite way to celebrate with some of the residents - grabbing a drink! Some of the resident's favourite way to unwind is to head down to the beach and grab a drink to wind down. The question is, can you pour the perfect drink?

I thought I'd start today's update by just reminding you that if you've been enjoying these updates and haven't given our demo a go it's still available through Steam! A massive thanks to everyone who has been wishlisting the game!

Hey everyone - it's time for another Spirittea update, and for today I promised we'd look at some of the spirits! 

I figured I'd show you how the seating arrangements in the bathhouse will work, and introduce you to either your new favourite or your first worst 'enemies' in the game - 

This guy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42404813/340b7257b44d575844a670367faab410cad1d5d2.png[/img]

More on him later. First let's head out to the bathhouse and chat about where you can seat your new spirit customers once you've helped them around town. 

In order to keep your spirits happy in their baths, you can do a whole range of things like scrub them and treat their water, but the easiest way to keep them happy is to seat them next to other spirits they like! In the beginning when you have one bath this might be tough, but as you speak to Fae and unlock more, you'll be able to use more bath space - it's like a lovely puzzle! 

Each spirit is linked to a season, and they love sitting next to spirits of the same season or the seasons next to theirs - they don't like sitting next to the season at the opposite end of the year.  This image should hopefully clear it up, but Spring spirits hate for example hate sitting next to Autumn (or Fall) spirits, but like their neighbours Winter and Summer!

Once you've worked out who likes who, and you've got your seating plan, you can plonk down your spirits and they'll stay in the lovely spaces you've found for them, right?

Right?

Meet Corvink, a cheeky lad with a love of the arts! Corvink is happy to grab a towel and be seated, but... well

He's also a fan of getting his laps in. He's one of the special anomalous spirits who has a special effect once he's in the bath, adding layers to your bathhouse puzzle! The question is: would you want to give Corvinks their own baths, set up some season-based baths or pop everyone in together?  

I can't WAIT to show you some of the other spirits and talk you through some neat features of the bathhouse, but for today say hello to my favourite cheeky chappie, and I'll see you in the next update!

notes.title: Dev Update - Meet Amelia!
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=pnUM26mwzbw;full][/previewyoutube]

Hey everyone, welcome back to another little Spirittea update! One of the big tasks is to breathe life into each of the Townspeople - and that's being done in part with brand-new sets of animations!

With these new animations new being finished, I thought I'd use them to introduce our cast of characters - so first up is the first to be finished, and that's lovely Amelia! 

You will have heard us talking about Amelia in our first update video, make sure you pop back to that to see how you'll meet her for the first time!

Amelia likes traditional music, dancing, and gardening, she's best friends with Miko and Quill who you'll meet very early on, and has a little special interest in Clarence (but I won't dwell on that so I don't embarrass her - they're both so sweet!) 

You'll regularly see Amelia having tea and farming with Miko, as well as preparing food and practising her Tai Chi! 

She's also a big fan of calligraphy, feeling like every brushstroke tells a story, and loves expressing herself that way!

Each Townsperson has their routine, so you'll see them taking part in their own activities frequently!

Amelia is very extroverted, relaxed, and practical, so has become a firm favourite of ours pretty quickly. She just wants to see her daughter (Song) and grandson (Momo) live a happy life, so you'll regularly find her in the shop helping out! She knows the struggle of raising a child on her own, so looks to support Song wherever she can!

These animations are really making the world come alive, and as each one gets added I can't help but get more excited! Let us know which one is your favourite, and we'll look at something new again next week! See you then!

notes.title: Dev Update - A Big Mess
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=qL6fw77XcoQ;full][/previewyoutube]

Hey there everyone! It's Friday, so it's time for another Spirittea update! Since we first released the demo a whole host of things have changed, so I thought I'd round some of them up for you, before showing you my favourite feature that's finally here!

In the last update I mentioned the map - thanks to lovely Granny Amelia's help this is now on the M key, something I know a lot of folks were asking about when the demo came out! Throughout the game you'll need to use the map to track down particular people to help them with their problems, so we've taken your feedback on board and made it nice and easy to get to! 

Talking of speaking to people and solving their problems, the order of quests has been toyed with and changed around this week - it's important to us that you're able to find and follow the stories as you play, so alongside being able to track down who you're looking for, we also wanted to make sure we gave you all some pointers as to where to check first! On the new first day, you'll hear about the problems of two of our residents, and armed with your new map and your tea, hopefully, you'll be able to track down whichever naughty spirit is - AAAA, what're they doing there??

Right well, aside from THAT mess, we've also been making our own mess! Let me show you the inside of the bathhouse! We seem to have left it a little long since the demo and well... some spiders seem to have moved in! 

We wanted the bathhouse to feel like somewhere you could work on if you wanted and another location for you to really make your own! We also noticed some of you folks in the demo spent HOURS clearing up patches of dust and dirt. So uhh, we made you some more! Surprise! 

BUT that's not all the brushes are good for - introducing my new favourite feature (mostly because I am bad at organising my spirits) SCRUBBING YOUR BATH GOERS! 

If like me, you dump spirits wherever you have space, it makes them unhappy, which brings you in less money. Thankfully to can cheer them up a bit by giving them a scrub with your brush, which is something I have spent FAR too long doing this week! 

There are a couple of other changes balance-wise, but I'll leave them for another day. For now, look forward to some scrubbing, some cleaning and making the bathhouse really yours later this year!

notes.title: Dev Update - A New Beginning
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=-YwkJJwuDjU;full][/previewyoutube]

Hey there everyone! Happy 2023 from all of us at No More Robots and Cheesemaster Games - we're excited to make this the year of Spirittea! 

To kick off the brand new year, I figured I'd share some progress of one of the biggest changes to the game that it's had since the very beginning. I touched on in a text update last year - I'm excited to show you it in action. 

If you've played our lovely demo, you will have met granny Miko. We love this introduction to the town, but it didn't explain very much about the game, nor how to get around town very effectively. To help, we added a first day to help you get to grips with the town and your new neighbours - calling in our other granny, Amelia! 

Amelia will teach you a little about furniture and food, but most excitingly give you a map and brochure, showcasing a whole wealth of activities to get stuck into across town! We also have roped in the lovely Jan to help you track down anyone you haven't met yet, as this adds them to your map so you can find them whenever you need! Thanks Jan! The keen eyed among you will also notice that Jan and Maru got some visual upgrades, and of course that very important pet button! 

We're hoping this extra time to explore your surroundings and get a feel for the people, the town and the spoooky goings on will help you get to grips with your new mountain home, and inspire lots of adventures! There's plenty to get stuck into in every season - we can't wait to see which one ends up being your favourite! The seasons influence what you can find, what you can do and of course our spirit friends - but we'll talk about that in a later update! 

For now, we're much happier with the way the beginning of the game flows, and we hope you end up loving our quirky band of characters as much as we do! 

I'll see you next week for another update, where I can showcase my absolute favourite new feature - I've been waiting for it for a while, and finally I can make my bathing spirits happier than ever! I'll see you there!

notes.title: Dev Update - Improved Furry Friends!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! 

I'm so excited to get into today's update because honestly, it's the cutest feature I think I've ever seen in a game (as well as being pretty helpful!)! BUT! Before I get too carried away, don't forget we have a BRAND NEW TRAILER coming this Thursday, December 8th! 

While I have to keep it very under wraps, I'm excited for you to get a feel for what life in Spirittea will be like, and start looking forwards to planning your time in your own mountain towns! If you want to make sure you don't miss it, make sure you sign up for a reminder here - https://wholesomegames.com/

So, what has Cheesemaster Games been so hard at work on making both functional AND adorable? If you've played the demo, you might have met these two cuties - two Shiba Inus! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42404813/0018be4ac2c3210913e778672a824aa858930e29.png[/img]

Jan and Maru have had some visual upgrades to look more like their real-life counterparts! There have been so many visual upgrades throughout, but these two have been given a brand new mission to help out new players, so it was important they looked the part! Did you know that Shibas nearly went extinct during WW2? 

Looking back at the demo and early playthroughs of the game, we noticed that folks were getting lost and finding it hard to navigate - something we definitely didn't want in our lovely calm game! So, we decided to allow a little extra time before spirit mode kicks in so that everyone can wander around and get their bearings, chat with the locals and get a feel for what building houses who! We made some map improvements that I chatted about in our last update, but you'll need to find people before they'll appear on your map - don't worry though, help is at hand. 

No one likes being stuck at 25/27 townspeople met (certainly if your sense of direction is as bad as mine!) so we've drafted in loyal and friendly Jan and Maru to help! If you're not sure where to find someone, they'll happily sniff them out, and lead you to them! What useful neighbours! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42404813/5a78f71d87bc3e934b5374425116fb6b1ec9443c.png[/img]

We want to make sure throughout that we're keeping on top of making this a pleasant, chill experience for those who want to hang out, help their neighbours, have some fun and run their bathhouse. Being blocked by needing to find someone you've never met, or not being sure where someone is for a quest feels really unrewarding, so the work is going in to make sure everything is just as we'd like it, so you can fully enjoy your adventure the way you want to! 

We'll see you on Thursday for some new trailer action!! I'm so excited that we're part of the game awards, and I hope you folks are too!

notes.title: Spirittea Development Update #2: Showing you the outside world!
notes.notes:
Hey there everyone, I hope you’re all keeping well! I know lots of folks really enjoyed our last update and a look into what goes into our lovely interiors, so we figured we’d update you on some work going on on the OUTSIDE this time. There’s a lot that goes into balancing the outdoors and filling it with the right things, as well as making it a nice space for you to enjoy. With all that in mind, here is some of the work that’s been going into your new world!

In the last update, we talked a little bit about setting the tone of the game, and hoping that our stylized interiors give you a real feeling of the people that live there and the ambience of the town. There’s a lot of work to balance making it a place where the townspeople clearly live, filling it with interesting things to investigate and filling it with things that advance the story and house our lovely spirits! Making sure that you have enough space to explore, and that the town is alive but not FULL is definitely a difficult balance to strike! I don’t want to spoil anything JUST YET about some of the things you can find and interact with in the world, but it’s definitely been interesting to think about where everything GOES.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42404813/f3a879db94628f2a898c55bff787f0989c360c2b.png[/img]

Just like the interiors, everything has gone through planning and sketching, as well as just walking around the environment and feeling - what is this missing? My favourite example was the Temple area in the south, which just felt like it needed something more. We made some revisions to the temple structure itself, as well as added in some more rocks to make the environment a little more exciting, but it definitely needed some atmosphere. In the end, we included a bell that would be rung in the early morning and evening, which could be heard all throughout town - Just another little element that will hopefully add to the atmosphere of the town!

Just like the interiors, we want everything to be interesting, memorable and be interesting to explore - the world is full of things to find and collect, as well as people to hang out with and clues as to the whereabouts of the spirits, but it can’t ONLY be full of those things. One of the little touches you might have seen in the demo is the bus. Originally the road parts of town felt a little flat, so the bus was added (though it did drive off into the sea and mow down all the NPCs in the process…) and almost INSTANTLY the town felt more alive, more like a real town.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42404813/09e581be07696e942f0cd318cfe16dcfd3a7927b.png[/img]

The next things we’re hoping will bring that breath of life into the game is the wildlife (which you might already have met!) and the townsfolks’ routines! There are some bird, frog and beach-based friends to discover in the demo!) and the NPCs going about their daily routines - I’m really excited to see these in action, showing off each character’s personality and giving you more to discover around the town! 

Based on the Demo, where are you most excited to explore in Spirittea? I can’t wait to get exploring again and find all these little details. Did you have a favourite in the Demo? Let us know!

notes.title: Spirittea Development Update: Making you feel at home, wherever you are!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! We’re still hard at work on Spirittea, and thought we’d start sharing some regular updates on development, as well as a little insight into how Spirittea has grown over the last few years! We’ll start with an important process we think has been REALLY COOL to see grow!

One of the important things that we think really sets the tone throughout the mountain town in Spirittea is potentially something that most folks might not realise so much planning went into - interiors! These have slowly become a way to tell stories and get the players to feel at home with cultures they might not have experienced before.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42404813/d16a8d19f92b811be65efae9e9896db12e7651ab.png[/img]

From the shops and houses in town to your lovely, large bathhouse, everything has gone through meticulous planning from a sketch level right through to the pixel art you’ve seen in our lovely demo! It’s all been important to get right so everything in Spirittea feels authentic to itself and the real-world influences that give it so much life (I have some AMAZING photos to show you in a later update!!)

The biggest one that kicked off making sure each indoor area was full of life, was planning out and drawing all of the objects inside the first floor of the local shop.  The shop is based on small little convenient store-type shops CheeseMaster encountered many times in Korea, particularly in more rural towns.  Many of these shops felt very lived-in and almost doubled as a living areas. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42404813/ddef1ac826782a12554e88c63d7b3534f8666f04.png[/img]

We want each area to be interesting and memorable, rather than dull and empty. It was an important homage to the feeling of home that a lot of these cultures foster naturally! So many of these became important during this stage of development, like the convenience store, restaurant and player home, then the local carpenter's workshop/home, the coffee shop, and the apartment building.  

[i]“The interiors are chock full of details which makes each room take a long time.  If I can finish one interior in two or three days I'm happy. I have to also plan out who lives where, and think about what sorts of things they might have in their home.  It's a challenging task, but is quite fun!"[/i]

We really hope you enjoy discovering all these little details when you play, it’s been a pure joy seeing them all come together. With each new addition, the mountain town slowly becomes more and more alive, and we cannot WAIT for you to join all our lovely characters and spirits and learn all about them!
